definition: A census is a systematic collection of data about an entire population or system rather than just a sample. In this context, school census data refers to records gathered across schools over time to describe educational conditions and practices.

reasons: The packet does not define what a “census” is (e.g., systematic collection of data about an entire population/system versus a sample).

The packet only mentions that the study “analyzes school census data from 2009 to 2022,” but it provides no explanation of what “school census data” refers to (e.g., records gathered across schools over time).
The definition’s added claims about describing “educational conditions and practices” are not explicitly supported in the packet text.

The first sentence gives a general dictionary-style definition of “census” as data collected from an entire population or system rather than a sample, but the packet only shows a study using “school census data” and does not support that broad definition.

The phrasing “in this context” adds an explanatory sense that is broader than the packet supports; the source only supports school census data as data analyzed over 2009–2022, not a general definition of census or a formal description of how censuses are collected.
